title: MCP server fail error on Claude Desktop and WSL on Windows / After Claude Code ver0.2.32 Update
body: On Windows, errors have suddenly started occurring on several MCP servers in Claude Desktop. This happened right when I updated Claude Code (CLI) to a new version(ver0.2.32). Simultaneously, Claude Code has also become unable to load MCP servers properly. (Everything was working normally until yesterday, and I haven't changed any settings.) These errors are occurring with custom MCP servers that were cloned from GitHub and built using npm run build. However, no errors are occurring with the official MCP servers provided by Anthropic (the ones installed via npm install -g). Additionally, on macOS, these custom MCP servers don't experience any errors. This is an urgent error report.
author: kawa0721
